# SteamLite 10.1.3

Themes you download, collections you make, and offline mode.

- When SteamLite cannot reach its servers, or offline mode is on, a small Offline mark appears next to the logo, and Messages, Friends and News show Not available while offline (error code 3: cannot reach steamlite servers) instead of the page. You can turn offline mode on from that page, which keeps those two pages closed and stops Messages checking for news, and turn it off again from the same place. Offline mode belongs to each profile.
- New Settings > Online: a switch for offline mode, and a Disconnect button that stops every request to the SteamLite servers (messages, friend codes, backups and your profile) until you press Connect again. Your SteamLite account stays signed in.
- Themes are no longer packed into SteamLite. They are hosted on GitHub with a screenshot of each one. The Themes page shows the screenshots, and Download opens a larger view with Back and Download under the screenshot; after downloading, the same button applies the theme. Downloaded themes are kept on your PC, so they work offline, and the list is kept for when GitHub cannot be reached. The reward themes you unlock with SteamLite achievements still come with the app. If you already use a theme, you keep it.
- Collections are back: the plus button next to the collection chips makes one, Delete collection (with Undo) removes the open one, and a game's three dots menu ticks it into or out of a collection. When there are more collections than fit, the rest go into a three dot menu.
- The title slides sideways when you open a collection and when you go back to Library.
